pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASSES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What words do we use to describe the position of people or objects in relation to others?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify prepositions correctly in oral and written texts
2. use prepositions correctly in varied texts

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify prepositions correctly in oral and written texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify prepositions correctly in oral and written texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use prepositions correctly in varied texts
   In simple words: practise until you can use prepositions correctly in varied texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes.
4. Show that you can: identify prepositions correctly in oral and written texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Classes important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct sentences on money and trade using prepositions,
2. Create crossword puzzles using prepositions in pairs or small groups,
3. Social Justice: It is inculcated in the learners as they display fairness while work with peers to create charts or posters showing where objects are.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify prepositions correctly in oral and written texts
2. use prepositions correctly in varied texts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
